players.name: Justin Herbert
players.note: As of Nov. 23 he was still in the concussion protocol after being sacked six times in the Nov. 22 loss to the Jets. DJ Uiagalelei would likely start Nov. 29 vs. New England if Herbert doesn't clear, and Wednesday's injury report should clarify his status.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.note: He hurt his left hand in the third quarter of the Nov. 23 MNF win over Cincinnati (22-20), but he returned after treatment and led the winning drive. He finished with 289 passing yards, 0 TD and 55 rushing yards, and the injury looks minor; watch the Week 12 practice reports.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He missed Week 11 with a Grade 2 hamstring strain. Minnesota is still targeting a Nov. 29 return vs. Atlanta, but that is a target rather than a confirmed date, and there was no new practice news as of Nov. 23.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: He went 26-of-38 for 235 yards, 0 TD and 1 INT on Nov. 22 vs. San Francisco. Kyler Murray (hamstring) is targeting a Nov. 29 return, which would likely send Cousins back to the bench.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as NE's backup QB as of 1:12 PM PT Nov 24.

players.name: Tommy DeVito
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as NE's starting QB as of 1:12 PM PT Nov 24.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as ARI's starting QB as of 1:12 PM PT Nov 24.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: Indianapolis released him Nov. 20, and Anthony Richardson is the waiver add replacing him. As of Nov. 24 no signing had been reported, so he has no starting role.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.note: He threw for 267 yards, 3 TD and 1 INT with 22 rushing yards on Nov. 22 (23.9 PPR points), even without his top receiver. Multiple outlets call him the top breakout QB add for Week 12.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: Cleveland was on bye in Week 11. He has thrown for 300+ yards in three straight starts, and outlets list him as the consensus Week 12 streamer vs. the Raiders.

players.name: Cam Ward
players.note: He had 248 passing yards, 2 TD and a rushing TD on Nov. 22 (22.2 PPR points), his third straight 20+ point game. He is being touted as a top 1QB streamer for Week 12.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as SEA's starting QB as of 1:12 PM PT Nov 24.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as SEA's backup QB as of 1:12 PM PT Nov 24.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: He went 18-of-38 for 173 yards and 1 TD with 33 rushing yards on Nov. 22 (14.2 PPR points). Jameis Winston is taking goal-line snaps, which caps McCarthy's upside.

players.name: Jameis Winston
players.note: He is running the Giants' goal-line package and scored a rushing TD on Nov. 22 (3 carries for 5 yards). He has TD-vulture value only in deep superflex leagues.

players.name: Kyle McCord
players.note: He went 12-of-33 for 102 yards, 0 TD and 1 INT on Nov. 22. He keeps starting only while Malik Willis is on IR (estimated return Dec. 13).

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: He is on IR (groin/core) with an estimated return of Dec. 13, and Jeff Hafley says surgery isn't expected. Kyle McCord's 102-yard outing on Nov. 22 makes Willis likely to reclaim the job when healthy.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: He went 11-of-21 for 141 yards with no TD on Nov. 22 (6.3 PPR points). He remains the Eagles' starter with Jalen Hurts on IR, and he has a plus Week 12 matchup at Dallas.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: He went 24-of-37 for 276 yards, 1 TD and 1 INT on Nov. 22 and remains Baltimore's starter with Lamar Jackson on IR.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after surgery on his fractured, dislocated right thumb, with a reported 6-9 week recovery timeline. Jacoby Brissett is starting.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR and is expected to miss the rest of 2026. Joe Milton is starting for Philadelphia.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR after knee surgery and is expected to miss the rest of the regular season. J.J. McCarthy is starting, and Jameis Winston is handling goal-line snaps.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: Washington activated Croskey-Merritt (groin) from IR on Nov. 23, and he led the backfield in Monday night's 22-20 win over Cincinnati with 13 carries for 54 yards and a TD plus 2 catches for 23 yards. He looks like the Commanders' lead back again.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: White (heel) was active for Monday's Nov. 23 game vs. Cincinnati, but the Week 11 box score shows no carries or catches for him, while Jacory Croskey-Merritt handled 13 carries and 3 targets. His fantasy role has dried up with Croskey-Merritt back.

players.name: Chase Brown
players.note: Brown managed just 6 carries for 6 yards plus 5 catches for 30 yards in Monday's Nov. 23 loss at Washington. Samaje Perine outplayed him (6-26 rushing, 4-71 receiving), which raises the risk of a committee.

players.name: Samaje Perine
players.note: Perine out-produced Chase Brown in Monday's Nov. 23 loss to Washington, with 6 carries for 26 yards and 4 catches for 71 yards on roughly half the snaps. He has earned a bigger share of Cincinnati's backfield.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Williams (toe) practiced fully Monday, Nov. 23, after being limited Sunday, so he looks on track for Wednesday's game vs. Green Bay. He is still likely to share work with Blake Corum.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Jacobs (finger surgery) was limited again Monday, Nov. 23, and Matt LaFleur said he is unlikely to play Wednesday vs. the Rams.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Matt LaFleur said Nov. 23 that Josh Jacobs is unlikely to play Wednesday vs. the Rams, so Johnson is expected to lead Green Bay's backfield again, along with MarShawn Lloyd.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Liam Coen said Nov. 23 that Tuten re-aggravated his ankle Sunday vs. the Giants, but it 'wasn't too bad' and he'll practice as 'business as usual.' His Week 12 status vs. Tennessee will become clearer on Wednesday's injury report.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: He's a popular Week 12 waiver add as Bhayshul Tuten's backup, but Liam Coen said Nov. 23 that Tuten's ankle re-aggravation 'wasn't too bad,' which limits Rodriguez's chances of a bigger role.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Philadelphia's estimated Monday (Nov. 23) report listed Barkley as limited with neck and illness designations after he left the Week 11 game with an arm injury; his hamstring listing is gone. He says he expects to play Thursday at Dallas, and Will Shipley would get the work if he can't.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Walker (groin) was listed as a non-participant in Kansas City's Monday, Nov. 23, walkthrough after missing two straight games. Andy Reid is being cautious ahead of Thursday night's game vs. Buffalo.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: With Kenneth Walker III (groin) not practicing Nov. 23, Andy Reid said Johnson 'would take the bulk of the carries' Thursday vs. Buffalo. He's coming off 23 carries for 105 yards and a TD plus 4 catches for 38 yards in Week 11.

players.name: Justice Hill
players.note: Hill had his best game of the season Nov. 22 vs. Carolina: 6 carries for 69 yards and a TD plus 4 catches for 27 yards. He has 23 targets over Baltimore's last four games and is a top Week 12 waiver target.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Sampson has out-snapped Quinshon Judkins in three straight games, turning Cleveland's backfield into a 50-50 committee, and he is a top Week 12 waiver add per Nov. 24 reports.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Dylan Sampson has out-snapped Judkins in three straight games, so Cleveland's backfield is now roughly a 50-50 committee and Judkins' weekly ceiling is lower.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery returned from a groin injury in Week 11 vs. Indianapolis with 26 carries for 107 yards plus 3 catches for 17 yards. Woody Marks (concussion) may clear the protocol for Week 12 vs. Baltimore, which could cut into his workload.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks (concussion) missed Week 11, but Houston's Week 12 outlook gives him a good chance to clear the protocol before Sunday's game vs. Baltimore; Wednesday's practice report will tell. David Montgomery returned and took 26 carries in his absence.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: With Tyjae Spears placed on IR Nov. 21 and Nicholas Singleton inactive, Pollard had 21 carries for 110 yards in Week 11. He's set for a heavy workload.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: A Nov. 23 update says Love (right high ankle sprain, IR since Nov. 3) will miss at least one more game; Week 13 is the earliest he could be activated, and some reports point to Dec. 6.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Brooks returned to practice after being designated to return from IR on Nov. 11, but Chuba Hubbard just took 27 carries for 120 yards and 2 TDs on Nov. 22. Brooks is unlikely to have a big role even once he's activated.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman is Denver's clear lead back after 24 carries for 111 yards and 3 TDs plus 4 catches on Nov. 22, while J.K. Dobbins got 1 carry. RJ Harvey (knee, IR) isn't estimated back until around Dec. 6.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Dobbins played 1 snap and got 1 carry on Nov. 22 while Jonah Coleman took 24, so he has no fantasy role right now.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Kamara played 8 of 72 snaps on Nov. 22 and had 1 carry, with a 1-yard TD catch saving his day, while Travis Etienne Jr. took 14 carries. He has been reduced to a change-of-pace role.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: Etienne led New Orleans with 14 carries for 76 yards on Nov. 22, while Alvin Kamara got 1 carry, making him the Saints' early-down back.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Bowers (ankle) missed the Raiders' Week 11 game on Nov 22 and is still listed out on Sleeper as of Nov 23. Michael Mayer started in his place and caught 1 of 4 targets for 4 yards.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Kincaid (thumb) missed Week 11 on Nov 22 and was still listed out on Sleeper as of the evening of Nov 23, so his Week 12 status is in doubt.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.note: Johnson played through a hamstring injury in Week 11 on Nov 22 but was on the field for only 27 of 72 offensive snaps, with 1 target and no catches. He is still listed questionable on Sleeper as of Nov 23.

players.name: Sam LaPorta
players.note: LaPorta played 53 of 58 snaps in Week 11 on Nov 22 and caught 3 of 6 targets for 62 yards, but Sleeper added an ankle injury and a questionable tag on Nov 23. Detroit plays on Thanksgiving, so the short week makes his status worth monitoring.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: Goedert played 47 of 53 snaps in Week 11 on Nov 22 but drew only 1 target, which he caught for 38 yards. Sleeper listed him questionable with a shin injury on Nov 23.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (ankle) is still on IR on Sleeper as of Nov 23. Sean McVay said on Nov 14 that he would miss 'another couple weeks', so Week 12 is the earliest he could return.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Drake Maye (fractured fibula, per NFL.com on Nov 15) is expected to miss significant time, which leaves Tommy DeVito at QB after the Patriots' Week 11 bye. That lowers Henry's ceiling the rest of the way.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: In his Week 11 return on Nov 22, Hockenson caught 6 of 7 targets for 55 yards, but he played only 34 of 67 snaps. Jordan Addison is out after thumb surgery, which should keep his target share strong once his snaps ramp up.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: Williams led Washington with 11 targets and caught 9 of them for 122 yards vs. Cincinnati on Monday Night Football (Nov 23). That was the most targets of any pass-catcher in the game, and it points to a growing role.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown (hamstring, hurt Nov 15) is still listed out as of Nov 24, and no new timeline has been reported. Mike Vrabel said last week he did not expect Brown to be available coming out of the Week 11 bye, which puts Week 12 at the Chargers in doubt.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: Sleeper shows he was released by SF as of 1:12 PM PT Nov 24; check his new role.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (hamstring) has missed four straight games, including Week 11 on Nov 22. He was still listed out as of Nov 24.

players.name: Drake London
players.note: Sleeper still lists London questionable (head) as of Nov 24, coming out of Atlanta's Week 11 bye. Reports say he was cleared after a concussion check, but watch the practice reports this week ahead of Week 12 at Minnesota.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Bernard played 67 of 71 snaps at Philadelphia on Nov 22 and caught 6 of 10 targets for 40 yards. DK Metcalf managed only 1 catch for 2 yards in the same game.

players.name: DK Metcalf
players.note: Metcalf played through a questionable tag on Nov 22 but caught just 1 of 4 targets for 2 yards on 44 of 71 snaps. Rookie Germie Bernard drew 10 targets in that game.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Lane played 33 of 65 snaps in Week 11 on Nov 22 but did not draw a target. A week earlier he had 11 targets, so his role looks volatile.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sarratt was a coach's-decision inactive again on Nov 22, his second straight healthy scratch. He has no clear path to playing time without an injury in Baltimore's receiver room.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.note: Thomas played only 37 of 72 snaps vs. the Giants on Nov 22 and caught 1 of 3 targets for an 18-yard TD. Jakobi Meyers drew 10 targets in the same game.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams (hamstring surgery in late October) is still on IR, with no designation to return reported as of Nov 24. McVay had said he expected Adams back at the shorter end of a 6-10 week timeline, which puts a possible return around Weeks 12-13.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce (heel) remains on IR and did not play in Week 11. On Nov 11, Shane Steichen said he was unsure whether Pierce will return in 2026.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Bell played through a chest injury on Nov 22 but caught just 1 of 4 targets for 8 yards. He is still listed questionable (chest) as of Nov 24.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Moore played through a questionable (knee) tag in Week 11 on Nov 22 and caught 8 of 10 targets for 91 yards and a TD. Sleeper still lists him questionable as of Nov 24.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.note: Coker played 60 of 71 snaps in Week 11 on Nov 22 despite a questionable (undisclosed) tag, catching 4 of 7 targets for 47 yards. He is still listed questionable as of Nov 24.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison (thumb surgery) missed Week 11. Week 12 reports on Nov 24 say he is recovering well but is unlikely to play this week, and Tai Felton has been taking his targets.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) missed Week 11, and Week 12 injury lists as of Nov 24 still have him out. Yahoo has named him a drop candidate.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot, IR) is trending toward activation. Mike McCarthy said this week he is 'very confident' Pittman returns for Week 12 vs. Denver.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson played about 48 snaps in his first game back from IR on Nov 22 at Philadelphia, catching 3 of 6 targets for 43 yards. Michael Pittman Jr. is expected back from IR in Week 12, which would likely cut into Wilson's role.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder, IR) could return to practice this week, per Week 12 reports on Nov 24. A.J. Brown (hamstring) is doubtful, so Doubs could step into a larger role once he is activated.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua had MCL surgery the week of Nov 17 and is expected to miss the rest of the regular season. He is also serving a three-game suspension.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season after a back/neck fracture suffered Nov 8 vs. Seattle. Harrison Wallace III led Arizona's wideouts in Week 11.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin is out for the 2026 season after tearing his left patellar tendon on Oct 19. Rookie Antonio Williams (9-122 on MNF Nov 23) has emerged as Washington's top receiver.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Cooper (ankle/hip) missed the Jets' Nov 22 win over the Chargers. It was his third ankle injury this year, and he could miss multiple weeks.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring, Week 8) had not been reported practicing as of Nov 20. Atlanta's Week 11 bye gave him extra recovery time, and his Week 12 status depends on this week's practices.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: As of Nov 24, Hill is still unsigned and has not been medically cleared from his knee injury. Suitors are reportedly waiting for clearance.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey returned from a back injury on Nov 22 in a full-time role (5-37-2 on 8 targets vs. the Jets). Justin Herbert's concussion status headlines the Week 12 injury reports and clouds the outlook vs. New England.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: With McConkey back full-time on Nov 22, Harris fell to 2 catches for 28 yards on 2 targets vs. the Jets. Justin Herbert is also in the concussion protocol.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans returned from Achilles tendinitis on Nov 22 after missing three games. He caught 6 of 7 targets for 109 yards and a TD vs. Minnesota on just 23 snaps.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: With Mike Evans back on Nov 22, Allen was held to 3 catches for 38 yards on 4 targets vs. Minnesota, so his fill-in role is shrinking.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson was held to 1 catch for 6 yards on 2 targets (36 snaps) at Chicago on Nov 22. Kellen Moore blamed personnel sequencing for keeping him off the field, and Chris Olave drew 15 targets.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: With DeVonta Smith back on Nov 22, Lemon managed 1 catch for 3 yards on 3 targets vs. Pittsburgh. His fill-in WR1 volume is gone.

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.note: With Jaylen Waddle back from his concussion on Nov 22, Bryant slipped to 3 catches for 32 yards on 4 targets vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: Skyler Bell
players.note: Bell was a coach's-decision inactive for Week 11 vs. Miami on Nov 22, which leaves him outside Buffalo's receiver rotation for now.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.note: Washington drew 17 targets at the Giants on Nov 22, catching 8 for 103 yards, which cements his lead role in Jacksonville's injury-thinned receiver room.

players.name: Ted Hurst III
players.note: Hurst caught 5 of 7 targets for 56 yards and two TDs on Nov 22, out-targeting Emeka Egbuka. He is a popular Week 12 waiver add, and analysts call Tampa Bay's receiver pecking order wide open.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.note: Diggs caught 4 of 6 targets for 45 yards in the 22-20 MNF win over Cincinnati on Nov 23. Rookie Antonio Williams (9-122) led Washington's receivers and set up the winning field goal.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (toe) as of 1:12 PM PT Nov 24.

players.name: Jordan James
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:45 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: James (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game vs. Minnesota in Mexico City after limited practices Thursday and Friday (Nov. 19-20). His recent role has been mostly kick returns.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: Tate (shoulder) was limited in practice Nov 18-19 and reportedly is tracking toward a Week 11 return at Dallas after missing Weeks 8 and 10. He is still questionable, so check inactives before the 10 AM PT kickoff.

players.name: Nicholas Singleton
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Drew Allar
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (concussion) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: He is officially questionable (foot, right thumb) for Sunday's Nov. 22 game at Detroit after limited practices Thursday and Friday. Ian Rapoport reports he will play, and Tom Pelissero says he is good to go barring a setback.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Sleeper now lists him on injured reserve (ankle) as of 3:17 PM PT Nov 21.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (back) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.
